Economics.comment: Buffer storage of captured CO2 ahead of permanent injection. CAPEX in EUR/tCO2 storage capacity (linear, through the origin), opex_variable in EUR/tCO2 total output, opex_fixed as fraction of up-front CAPEX

Performance.comment: Lossless storage, no energy consumption. allow_only_one_direction = 0 keeps the model linear (no losses, so simultaneous charging/discharging has no effect)

Flexibility.comment: Charging/discharging capacity as a ratio of the storage size (per hour), no separate cost
